verdict.rationale: Trello documents native Power-Ups and integrations that bring favorite apps into boards and pull in data from outside services. Slack is explicitly named for capturing content into the Trello Inbox, and a community user references an existing Trello GitHub Power-Up. Google Drive is never mentioned, and there is no first-party documentation of a GitHub integration. missing for 10: any evidence of a native Google Drive integration, first-party documentation of the GitHub Power-Up, detail on Slack integration depth beyond Inbox capture, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Power-Ups and integrations allow you to bring additional features to your boards and integrate your favorite apps right into Trello.
They can pull information and data from outside services directly into Trello, giving you clear perspective on your favorite tools for work.
Capture every vital detail from emails, Slack, and more directly into your Trello Inbox.
Power up your teams by linking their favorite tools with Trello plugins.
modeled on the Trello GitHub power-up
